hotspots.name: Burned Prayer Tree
hotspots.description: Black knots cling to the branches where red prayer cloths used to hang. The lower bark is smoke-stained, but one strip of cloth survived beneath wet leaves, marked with ash in a careful hand.

hotspots.name: Ash Signal Mark
hotspots.description: The mark is not random soot. Three short strokes cross a longer line, angled toward the village road. Someone used a sacred tree as a message post and burned the rest to hide it.

hotspots.name: Chapel Steps
hotspots.description: The chapel steps are swept clean, except for a thin trail of gray ash caught in the cracks between stones. No one has claimed the broom.
